record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly set Adam learning rate to 9e-4 and weight decay to 1e-6, retaining width 128 and dropout 0.10. Slightly smaller updates paired with weak parameter shrinkage may stabilize fitting without the capacity reduction or reduced dropout used in regressed trials. Preserve features, embedding parameterization, GRU depth, history length, readout, scoring and loss. Retain seed 42, the 200-epoch cap, 200 batches per epoch, and one checkpoint per category.
